text: The letters of Kryptos are cut right through the copper, and the CIA says the table was flipped on purpose so it reads only from the back. Perhaps K4 is meant to be read from behind too.

Read the four carved lines right to left, or bottom to top, or both, then try a repeating secret word of 1 to 26 letters and the self-feeding keys (autokeys) at every lag against the 24 known letters.
No reading fits a word shorter than 26 letters, and at 26 only as often as scrambled coppers; no autokey survives with three checks. Reading from behind changes nothing.
